info.title: Delivery Plus Admin API
info.description: Staff admin contract for the Delivery Plus platform (#212). Each service owns its own /admin routes; the gateway publishes them under /api/admin/<service>. Requires a staff JWT (role ADMIN) carrying the route's permissions; SYSTEM tokens are refused with 401. Every mutation requires a reason and goes through the audit hook (#213).

StaffDriverRow.description: One driver in the staff lists and the review queue (#214).

StaffDriverApplication.description: The driver's application as staff see it (#207, #214).

lastReview.description: The latest decision, or null before the first one.

documents.description: The current version of each uploaded document. Read one with POST /api/admin/drivers/{id}/documents/{type}/read-url.

expiringLicences.description: Licences valid today that expire within 14 days (Cairo), soonest first.

reviews.description: Every decision, newest first, with the document versions it looked at.

summary.description: Ledger balance and rating from delivery-service; null when it doesn't answer.

DriverDocumentReadUrl.description: A short-lived URL to one document (#207, #323); the read is recorded.

url.description: Valid for expiresIn seconds. Never store or log it.

undone.description: False when there was nothing to undo.

DriverActionResult.description: The result of a suspend or reactivate (#215).

suspensionRequestedAt.description: Set while a driver on a delivery waits to be suspended.

changed.description: False when the driver was already in that state.

StaffRestaurantRow.description: One restaurant in the staff lists and the review queue (#214).

deliveryRadiusKm.description: This restaurant's own radius in km as a decimal string; null uses the platform default.

StaffRestaurantApplication.description: The restaurant's application as staff see it (#208, #214).

deliveryRadiusKm.description: The radius in effect, in km.

lastReview.description: The latest decision, or null before the first one.

menu.description: Counts from the public menu; null when menu-service doesn't answer.

ordersToday.description: Orders since midnight Cairo time; null when order-service doesn't answer.

undone.description: False when there was nothing to undo.

RestaurantActionResult.description: The result of a suspend or reactivate (#215).

changed.description: False when the restaurant was already in that state.

StaffUserView.description: One person in the staff directory (#214): profile and account, personal data masked.

email.description: Masked (#317), or empty when the account has none; reveal it with POST /api/admin/users/{id}/reveal.
Masked (#317), or empty when the account has none; reveal it with POST /api/admin/users/{id}/reveal.

hasAddress.description: Whether there is an address to reveal; never the address itself.

driverId.description: The driver record of a DRIVER account, null when there is none, or 'unavailable'.

restaurantIds.description: The restaurants of a RESTAURANT_OWNER account, or 'unavailable'.

AccountActionResult.description: The result of suspend, reactivate or sign out everywhere (#215).

changed.description: False when the account was already in that state.

StaffMember.description: One staff member (#216): never hashes, tokens or lockout counters.

status.description: SUSPENDED is a disabled staff member.

StaffRoleTemplates.description: Permission sets the staff page offers when inviting (#216). A staff member holds permissions, never a role.

StaffInvitation.description: An invitation sent by email (#216); the token is only in the email.

AuditEvent.description: One staff action in the append-only audit log (#213).

permission.description: The permission the action was allowed by.

before.description: Changed fields before, personal data redacted.

after.description: Changed fields after, personal data redacted.

RevealedField.description: One revealed personal field (#317), recorded as a pii.reveal audit event.

value.description: The unmasked value, or null when there is none. Never store or log it.
